ev.q: Half-Life is a 1998 first-person shooter (FPS) game
received acclaim for its graphics, gameplay and narrative
Its gameplay consists of combat, exploration and puzzles
The science fiction novelist Marc Laidlaw was hired to craft the plot
The player controls Gordon Freeman, a theoretical physicist who must escape
It is fast paced, it is dramatic
The final portion of the game, taking place in the alien world of Xen, was generally considered the weakest
The player is occasionally assisted by security guards and scientists
Half-Life includes online multiplayer support for both individual and team-based deathmatch modes
